descriptionEn: An apartment is offered for rent on Rruga Hysen Xhakolli, Fushë Kosovë

The apartment is located in the Apollonia A20 complex, built by the well-known company Tregtia, in a strategic location near the streets Besa Besë, Hysen Xhakolli and Rruga Dardania, as well as near markets, public institutions and the main services. The area is quiet, established and suitable for family living.

The space includes a living room, a kitchen, 2 bedrooms, a bathroom + WC and a balcony enclosed with folding glass panels with an open view. The apartment has abundant natural light, a functional layout, and the space is suitable for long-term living.
In addition, the apartment offers dedicated parking for residents, a secured corridor in front of the entrance and a balcony usable all year round.
